cues.en: Instructor: Alright let's do some formal model comparisons.
cues.zh: 講師：來進行正式模型比較。

cues.en: What you are going to learn in this video is how to test different models of the same data quantitatively and statistically determine whether a more complicated model
cues.zh: 這支影片會學到，如何量化檢驗同一資料的不同模型，以統計判定較複雜的模型，

cues.en: is really worth the cost of adding extra parameters.
cues.zh: 是否真的值得付出增加參數的代價。

cues.en: So let's start with this blast from the past, I mean, technically two videos ago was the past, but so the idea here is that this was kind
cues.zh: 先回顧過去，技術上兩支影片之前也算過去；當時是比較

cues.en: of qualitative, two videos ago I talked about under fitting and overfitting, and I hinted that there were quantitative methods, but I was really just approaching it in
cues.zh: 定性的討論，談擬合不足與過度擬合，暗示有量化方法，但影片主要是從

cues.en: that video from a very qualitative perspective.
cues.zh: 定性角度處理。

cues.en: So that's what we're gonna do now, we're going to translate this qualitative understanding into a quantitative and statistical procedure.
cues.zh: 現在要把這個定性理解，轉成量化統計程序。

cues.en: So we need to start by talking about nested models.
cues.zh: 先討論巢狀模型。

cues.en: So we're going to define what it means for a model to be nested.
cues.zh: 定義模型的巢狀關係。

cues.en: Here we have two models, model one, model two, and you can see that they're both the same model except for model two has this additional term.
cues.zh: 兩個模型，模型一與模型二，除了模型二多這一項，其他相同。

cues.en: So beta three, and then the interaction of S and H.
cues.zh: beta3，以及 S 與 H 的交互作用。

cues.en: So I would like you to pause the video and figure out on your own, take a guess, what do you think it means for a model to be nested
cues.zh: 請暫停，自己猜猜，一個模型巢狀於

cues.en: underneath another model?
cues.zh: 另一個模型之下，代表什麼？

cues.en: Okay, how did it go, did you figure it out?
cues.zh: 想出來了嗎？

cues.en: I think it's fairly intuitive.
cues.zh: 我覺得相當直覺。

cues.en: You should figure out that this model one is nested underneath model two.
cues.zh: 應該能發現，模型一巢狀於模型二之下。

cues.en: So there's a couple of different terms that people use.
cues.zh: 人們用幾種不同術語。

cues.en: Model two is often called the full model, sometimes the extended model, and model one would be called the reduced model or the nested model.
cues.zh: 模型二常稱完整模型，有時叫擴充模型；模型一則叫縮減模型，或巢狀模型。

cues.en: So let's have a definition here of what nesting means.
cues.zh: 定義如下。

cues.en: So a model is nested under another model if it contains some of the identical predictors, but not all of them.
cues.zh: 一個模型包含另一模型部分相同的預測變數，但不是全部，

cues.en: And if the dependent variable is the same.
cues.zh: 而且依變數相同，就巢狀於另一模型。

cues.en: So the dependent variables are the same, these independent variables are the same, but we're missing some independent variables.
cues.zh: 依變數相同，這些自變數相同，但少了部分自變數。

cues.en: So we've dropped some.
cues.zh: 刪掉一些。

cues.en: Now it's important to realize that many models can be nested under the same full model, and nested models can also differ by more than one parameter.
cues.zh: 重要的是，許多模型可以巢狀於同一完整模型，巢狀模型也可以相差超過一個參數。

cues.en: So we could have another model, let's call this model, maybe this would be model one A, and then we can have model one B, and that would be Y equals beta zero,
cues.zh: 例如另一個模型，這個也許叫模型 1A，再有 1B，Y 等於 beta0，

cues.en: plus beta one S plus epsilon.
cues.zh: 加 beta1 S，再加 epsilon。

cues.en: So model one B is also going to drop this term.
cues.zh: 1B 還刪掉這一項。

cues.en: So then we have model one B is nested under model two, and it's missing two terms.
cues.zh: 所以 1B 巢狀於模型二，少了兩項。

cues.en: It's not just missing one term, it's missing two terms.
cues.zh: 不只一項，是兩項。

cues.en: And you can do all sorts of things.
cues.zh: 可以做各種安排。

cues.en: You can also have a model that drops this term but keeps the interaction term.
cues.zh: 也能刪掉這一項，卻保留交互作用項。

cues.en: So all sorts of ways that you can nest models under each other.
cues.zh: 有各種巢狀模型方式。

cues.en: That said, when you're doing formal model comparisons, like the way I will show you here, it's good practice to have the nested model differ
cues.zh: 但做這裡要展示的正式模型比較時，讓巢狀模型

cues.en: by only one parameter.
cues.zh: 只相差一個參數，是好習慣。

cues.en: And the reason for having it differ by only one parameter is that it just facilitates the interpretation.
cues.zh: 只讓模型相差一個參數的原因，是這樣比較方便解讀。

cues.en: So let's say we have a, we'll call this model zero where we just say Y equals beta zero.
cues.zh: 例如模型零，只有 Y 等於 beta0。

cues.en: So just the intercept plus the epsilon plus the residuals term.
cues.zh: 只有截距，再加 epsilon、殘差。

cues.en: So now when we compare model zero to model two, they differ by one to three terms and three parameters.
cues.zh: 模型零與模型二比較，就相差一、二、三項，三個參數。

cues.en: So when we find that those models are different from each other, it gets hard to know exactly which parameter is causing that difference.
cues.zh: 發現模型不同時，就難以知道究竟是哪個參數造成差異。

cues.en: So yeah, just for interpretation, it's useful, but certainly not necessary to have your nested models differ by only one parameter from the full model.
cues.zh: 所以只差一個參數有助解讀，但當然不是必要條件。

cues.en: Okay, and here is something important to keep in mind.
cues.zh: 有個重要事情要記住。

cues.en: The full model is always going to fit the data better than the reduced model.
cues.zh: 完整模型對資料的擬合，總是比縮減模型好。

cues.en: That's just how things work in statistics, more complicated models necessarily fit the data better.
cues.zh: 統計就是如此，較複雜的模型必然擬合更好。

cues.en: The more parameters you add, the better you are going to fit the data.
cues.zh: 參數愈多，擬合愈好。

cues.en: The question is, is it justified?
cues.zh: 問題是，合理嗎？

cues.en: Are you justified to add those extra parameters?
cues.zh: 增加那些參數，有沒有正當理由？

cues.en: And that is not always the case.
cues.zh: 不一定有。

cues.en: And that's what we need to determine and that's what we're going to determine in this video.
cues.zh: 這就是這支影片要判定的。

cues.en: So the idea is that models that have more parameters will always fit the data better, but we want to penalize the models, we wanna dock the models
cues.zh: 更多參數總是更好擬合，但我們要因為參數更多，對模型施加懲罰，

cues.en: or add a cost function to the models for having more parameters.
cues.zh: 扣分，或加入成本函數。

cues.en: So that means that having more parameters, which means more complex models is justified.
cues.zh: 因此，只有在更多參數，也就是更複雜模型合理時，

cues.en: It's allowed only when the model really, really, really significantly improves the fit to the data.
cues.zh: 真正非常顯著地改善擬合，才允許。

cues.en: So that's the idea, okay, so how are we going to do this?
cues.zh: 概念如此，要怎麼做？

cues.en: How do we come up with a statistical test to compare the nested model to the full model?
cues.zh: 如何建立統計檢定，比較巢狀模型與完整模型？

cues.en: Well, it's going to involve an F test, and I would like you to guess what kind of quantity we are going to need to compute in order to do this comparison.
cues.zh: 會用到 F 檢定，猜猜為了比較，需要計算什麼量？

cues.en: If you need a little hint, it's pretty much the only quantity that we've been using to do statistical evaluations in the past two sections.
cues.zh: 提示是，前兩個單元做統計評估，幾乎只用這個量。

cues.en: So regression and ANOVA.
cues.zh: 也就是迴歸與 ANOVA。

cues.en: It's pretty much the only quantity we care about in all general linear models.
cues.zh: 所有一般線性模型，幾乎只關心它。

cues.en: And that is, you guessed it, the sum of squared errors.
cues.zh: 猜對了，就是平方誤差和。

cues.en: So we are going to need the sum of squared errors of the residuals and that is defined as the sum of the observed data points minus
cues.zh: 需要殘差平方和，定義為觀察資料點減去

cues.en: each predicted data point squared.
cues.zh: 各自預測資料點，平方後加總。

cues.en: And this is a little mistake here.
cues.zh: 這裡有個小錯誤。

cues.en: This should say Y hat sub I.
cues.zh: 應寫成 yHat 下標 i。

cues.en: So this is the Iith or the model prediction for the Iith data point minus the observe, the actual Iith data point.
cues.zh: 第 i 個資料點的模型預測，減去實際觀察到的第 i 個資料點。

cues.en: And then we square all of those and sum those together.
cues.zh: 全部平方，再加總。

cues.en: That is our sum of squared errors.
cues.zh: 這就是平方誤差和。

cues.en: And this is really the basis for our F test for model comparisons.
cues.zh: 也是模型比較 F 檢定的基礎。

cues.en: So here's the formula and now I'm gonna spend a few moments walking you through this formula to make sure we understand it because it's a little complicated at first.
cues.zh: 這是公式，花一點時間說明，確保理解，因為起初有點複雜。

cues.en: So it's an F test, we have a ratio, it's an F ratio, and we have numerator and denominator degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: F 檢定是一個比值、F 比值，有分子與分母自由度。

cues.en: The numerator degrees of freedom are P minus K, P is the full model number of parameters, and K is the number of parameters in the reduced model.
cues.zh: 分子自由度是 P 減 K，P 是完整模型參數數量，K 是縮減模型參數數量。

cues.en: So let me go back a slide just to make sure that this is clear.
cues.zh: 回上一張，確保清楚。

cues.en: So if the full model here is model two, we have P equals 1, 2, 3, 4, and the reduced model is model one.
cues.zh: 如果完整模型是模型二，P 等於 1、2、3、4；縮減模型是模型一。

cues.en: That's the nested model, and that has K equals 1, 2, 3.
cues.zh: 就是巢狀模型，K 等於 1、2、3。

cues.en: So in that case we have P equals four and three equals or K equals three.
cues.zh: 所以 P 等於 4，3 等於——或者說 K 等於 3。

cues.en: N of course is the number of data points you have in total.
cues.zh: N 當然是資料點總數。

cues.en: So then we have these SS's the sum of squared errors of the residuals.
cues.zh: 這些 SS，是殘差平方和。

cues.en: And we have SSF, that's the full model.
cues.zh: SSF 是完整模型。

cues.en: And SSR, that's the reduced model.
cues.zh: SSR 是縮減模型。

cues.en: And now we can, so looking at this ratio, let's just ignore this.
cues.zh: 看比值時，先忽略這一項。

cues.en: In fact, in our example from the previous slide, P minus K is actually equal to one.
cues.zh: 上一張例子，P 減 K 其實等於 1。

cues.en: So, but just in general ignore this term, we don't really, it's conceptually not very important.
cues.zh: 一般而言，先忽略這一項，概念上不是太重要。

cues.en: And also we can ignore the denominator entirely.
cues.zh: 分母也能先完全忽略。

cues.en: This is just a normalization factor to bring this thing down to ratio so we can evaluate this independent of the scale of the data.
cues.zh: 只是正規化因子，讓它成為比值，不受資料尺度影響，方便評估。

cues.en: So in fact, all we really care about, the thing that you really need to remember about this F test is this term in the numerator, this subtraction term.
cues.zh: 真正要記住的是分子的這一項，這個相減。

cues.en: And now we also have to remember that with sum of squares and model fitting, it's a little bit counterintuitive because when the model fits the data better,
cues.zh: 還要記住，平方和與擬合有點違反直覺，因為擬合更好時，

cues.en: the sum of squares actually gets smaller.
cues.zh: 平方和反而更小。

cues.en: So we expect that this numerator here is going to be positive because the sum of squares for the full model is going to fit the data better than
cues.zh: 預期分子為正，因為完整模型的平方和所對應的擬合，比

cues.en: for the reduced model because there's more parameters here and fewer parameters here.
cues.zh: 縮減模型更好，這裡參數較多，那裡較少。

cues.en: So when the model fits the data better, the sum of squared errors is going to be smaller.
cues.zh: 模型擬合更好，平方誤差和更小。

cues.en: Okay, so now let's consider two possibilities.
cues.zh: 考慮兩種可能。

cues.en: One possibility is that these two terms are pretty much the same.
cues.zh: 第一，兩項幾乎相同。

cues.en: We certainly expect this term to be smaller, but let's say it's only a little bit smaller compared to the reduced model.
cues.zh: 當然預期這項更小，但假設只比縮減模型小一點。

cues.en: So then the F statistic is going to be small, it's going to go towards zero when these two terms are pretty similar.
cues.zh: 那麼 F 統計量會很小，兩項接近時，F 趨近 0。

cues.en: Conversely, when the sum of squared errors from the full model is really, really small, so the model with the extra terms fits the data
cues.zh: 反過來，完整模型平方誤差和非常小，也就是多加項目的模型，

cues.en: really super duper a lot well, really a lot better than the reduced model, then this term actually gets large and the F ratio is getting larger
cues.zh: 擬合比縮減模型好非常多，這一項就變大，F 比值變大，

cues.en: because this term is really small relative to this term.
cues.zh: 因為這項相對另一項非常小。

cues.en: Okay, so what does that mean?
cues.zh: 代表什麼？

cues.en: So when we have a large F statistic, and how large it needs to be, of course depends on the degrees of freedom here, but when F is really large
cues.zh: F 很大時，當然需要多大取決於自由度，但如果很大，

cues.en: and it's statistically significant, that means that more parameters improved the model significantly.
cues.zh: 而且統計顯著，表示更多參數顯著改善模型。

cues.en: So we added more parameters and they significantly improved the model and therefore we actually prefer the more complicated model even though it has more complexity in it.
cues.zh: 加入參數，顯著改善模型，因此即使更複雜，也偏好較複雜模型。

cues.en: Conversely, when the F ratio here is non-significant, that means that the model with fewer parameters fits the data roughly as well.
cues.zh: 反過來，F 比值不顯著，表示較少參數的模型，擬合大致一樣好。

cues.en: It's actually going to be worse, but the question is how much worse?
cues.zh: 實際上會比較差，但問題是差多少？

cues.en: So the model with fewer parameters fits basically just as well as the model with more complicated parameters.
cues.zh: 較少參數模型，基本上與較複雜模型擬合得差不多。

cues.en: And there we prefer the simpler model and that's because we added model complexity and it didn't really buy us anything.
cues.zh: 這時偏好簡單模型，因為增加複雜度，沒真正帶來什麼。

cues.en: So therefore we prefer the simpler model.
cues.zh: 所以選簡單模型。

cues.en: Okay, I hope that makes sense.
cues.zh: 希望這樣合理。

cues.en: It's a little bit, I find it a little hard to wrap my head around at first because you have to think about better model fits corresponding to smaller sum of squared errors.
cues.zh: 一開始我也覺得難理解，因為必須想到，擬合更好對應更小平方誤差和。

cues.en: Okay, the last thing I wanna point out here is the formal test that this F test is actually testing or the formal hypotheses that this F test is actually computing.
cues.zh: 最後指出這個 F 檢定正式檢驗的內容，也就是假設。

cues.en: So the null hypothesis for this F test is basically that all of the extra parameters that are contained in the full model that are not contained in the nested model, that all
cues.zh: 虛無假設基本上是，完整模型比巢狀模型多出的所有參數，

cues.en: of those parameters are zero, every single one of them.
cues.zh: 全部為 0，每一個都為 0。

cues.en: And the null hypothesis is that at least one of those extra parameters is not equal to zero.
cues.zh: 虛無假設則是，至少一個額外參數不等於 0。

cues.en: So if you have a difference of let's say five parameters between the full model and the reduced model, then then with this alternative hypothesis,
cues.zh: 如果完整與縮減模型相差五個參數，這個對立假設，

cues.en: it's difficult to know.
cues.zh: 就很難知道，

cues.en: I mean, you don't actually know which beta coefficient is significant.
cues.zh: 究竟哪個 beta 係數顯著。

cues.en: You don't know which one is driving the improvement in model fit.
cues.zh: 不知道是哪個帶來擬合改善。

cues.en: So then you would have to go back and inspect that further using methods that you learned about earlier in this section.
cues.zh: 必須回頭用本單元先前方法進一步檢查。

cues.en: So this is another illustration of why when you're doing this formal model comparison, why it's useful to have the full model and the reduced model differ by only one parameter.
cues.zh: 這再次說明，正式模型比較時，完整與縮減模型只差一個參數，為什麼有用。

cues.en: Again, it just makes things easier to interpret.
cues.zh: 只是更方便解讀。

cues.en: Okay, so in this video you learned about nested models, which are also sometimes called reduced and complete models or full models.
cues.zh: 這支影片學到了巢狀模型，也稱縮減與完整模型。

cues.en: And you learned about the F test for comparing these different models.
cues.zh: 也學到比較模型的 F 檢定。

cues.en: One final thing, which I forgot to mention earlier is that when you're doing this kind of model comparison, what you can actually do in practice
cues.zh: 先前忘記提，實際做這種模型比較時，

cues.en: is use your statistics program to compute the ANOVA tables or the regression tables and then get the sum of squared residuals from that table.
cues.zh: 可以用統計程式算出 ANOVA 表或迴歸表，再從表中取得殘差平方和。

cues.en: So you don't need to worry about computing the SSE yourself.
cues.zh: 不必擔心自己計算 SSE。

cues.en: You get that right from the table and then you just plug in the formula that I showed in the previous slide.
cues.zh: 直接從表格取得，代入上一張投影片的公式即可。
